name: gap_continuation_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps up > 0.4% at open on global cues or FII-driven overnight information, institutions with unfinished buy programs allow price to consolidate during 09:15-09:30 as the opening order queue clears. When NIFTY then closes above the 15-minute post-open range high (ORB high), VWAP-benchmarked algorithms — still below their target allocation — trigger systematic buy orders simultaneously, creating a 30-90 second directional burst. At 5-second resolution we enter at the exact ORB breakout bar rather than waiting for a 1-minute confirmation, capturing the first 10-15 spot points of institutional flow resumption before the burst exhausts. The inverse holds for gap-down: break below ORB low on a gap-down day signals continued institutional selling.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Identifies gap days. NIFTY gaps > 0.4% are overnight information events (global close, FII positioning, macro data) where institutional participants have genuine directional intent. Threshold set at 0.4% not 1.5% because index diversification compresses individual stock gaps by ~3-4x; a 0.4% NIFTY gap carries equivalent institutional conviction to a 1.5% single-stock gap.

indicators.name: orb_high_15
indicators.purpose: 15-minute opening range high. FIXED TIME WINDOW — same 15 minutes as original regardless of bar timeframe (180 bars at 5s = 15 minutes = 09:15-09:30). This range represents the supply ceiling during morning queue absorption. NOT scaled because the opening range is a clock-based concept, not a bar-count concept.

indicators.name: orb_low_15
indicators.purpose: 15-minute opening range low. Symmetric to orb_high_15. Break below signals continuation of gap-down with institutional selling.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as institutional benchmark. CUMULATIVE measure — no lookback scaling needed. On a gap-up day, bullish breakout only valid above VWAP (confirms VWAP-benchmarked algos still buying). Below VWAP on a gap-up day suggests the gap is being faded.

indicators.name: vol_sma_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling volume average (60 bars x 5s = 5 min). ORB breakout only valid with volume surge > 1.2x this average. Compressed from original 10-bar 1-min SMA (10 min) to 5 min because at 5s bars near-real-time volume confirmation is needed, not a 10-minute lagged reference.

conditions: volume > vol_sma_60 * vol_ratio (confirming volume surge, default 1.2x)
buy_ce.confirmation: 5-second bar closes above 15-min ORB high on a gap-up day with volume confirmation

conditions: volume > vol_sma_60 * vol_ratio (confirming volume surge, default 1.2x)
buy_pe.confirmation: 5-second bar closes below 15-min ORB low on a gap-down day with volume confirmation

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). If NIFTY reverses back inside the ORB after the breakout, the institutional flow thesis is invalidated — false ORB breakouts typically retrace 6-10 spot pts within 30 seconds. 4 pts allows noise without absorbing a full reversal.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot points). Post-ORB gap continuation bursts typically extend 15-20 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds as stacked buy orders execute. 7 pts captures the lower end of this extension with 1:1.75 R:R, calibrated to typical NIFTY 1-minute move of 3-7 option pts.

filters.vix_filter: none — gap continuation persists across vol regimes; high-VIX days have larger gaps that continue more strongly
filters.time_filter: entry only 09:30-10:30 IST; after 10:30 gap momentum dissipates as VWAP reverts and late participants fade the gap
filters.volume_filter: volume > 1.2x 5-min rolling SMA at breakout bar
filters.trend_filter: VWAP filter ensures direction aligns with institutional benchmark
filters.spread_filter: none (limit order execution at close price)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — institutional VWAP-benchmarked algos create structural ORB continuation; index-level flow, not stock-specific news

adaptation_notes: Original traded individual Nifty50 stocks gapping > 1.5%. Converted to NIFTY index: (1) gap threshold reduced from 1.5% to 0.4% — index diversification compresses moves ~3-4x, same conviction = smaller index gap; (2) hold time compressed from 15-60 min to 30-90s by entering at the 5-second ORB breakout bar rather than waiting for 1-min confirmation; (3) ORB time window stays at exactly 15 minutes (180 bars at 5s) — clock-based concept, not bar-count; (4) vol_sma window compressed from 10-min to 5-min for faster volume confirmation; (5) stock-level catalysts replaced by index-level overnight information (SGX Nifty, global close, FII positioning).
weaknesses: NIFTY gaps > 0.4% occur on ~30-40% of trading days — strategy is idle on flat-open days
Post-ORB breakout on gap days can be false (trapped longs, algo stop hunts) — volume filter reduces but does not eliminate this
Gap continuation tends to work for first 45-60 min; late entries near 10:30 have lower hit rate
Correlated with global markets — consecutive false breakout days possible during range-bound global sessions
